title: Ranging over ints and maps
hints: Since Go 1.22, for i := range n counts i from 0 to n-1. Map iteration order is deliberately unpredictable, so sort the keys if order matters.
Collect the keys into a slice while ranging over the map, then sort them with slices.Sort. In Squares, append (i+1)*(i+1) for each i in range n.
keys := make([]string, 0, len(m)); for k := range m { keys = append(keys, k) }; slices.Sort(keys); return keys.
